description: This file implements a custom memory allocation wrapper with tracking and OS-specific RSS retrieval functions, used in the Redis project.

methods.name: zmalloc
methods.description: Allocates memory with tracking of total used memory, with OS-specific handling.

methods.name: zrealloc
methods.description: Reallocates memory with tracking, handling system-specific details.

methods.name: zstrdup
methods.description: Duplicates a string with custom allocator and tracking.

methods.name: zmalloc_used_memory
methods.description: Returns total allocated memory tracked by zmalloc.

methods.name: zmalloc_get_rss
methods.description: Retrieves resident set size (RSS) in an OS-specific way.

methods.name: zmalloc_get_fragmentation_ratio
methods.description: Calculates fragmentation ratio based on RSS and allocated memory.

methods.name: zmalloc_get_smap_bytes_by_field
methods.description: Reads /proc/self/smaps to get memory field in bytes.

methods.name: zmalloc_get_private_dirty
methods.description: Gets private dirty memory in bytes from /proc/self/smaps.
